unit: Discovery fetch-timestamp provenance fix (general and continuation routes)

defect.summary: General discovery, scheduled continuation, and batch research stamped last_fetched = invocation time on every harvested link candidate and AI suggestion, including documents that were never fetched. This was the defect family behind the October 21 Sharonville live repair; the selected-document route was fixed earlier, these routes were not.
defect.evidence_of_prior_behavior: Octa (6ad05ac8acc3c782f0027f9c) live readback showed all 15 documents carrying last_fetched dates from a previous cycle, including documents never fetched.

base44/shared/permittingDiscoveryScan.mj: Added discoveryFetchedUrlKeys(scan): URL-key set of pages whose status is 'scanned' or 'classified_pdf' (both url and final_url normalized through the existing key()).

Added applyDiscoveryFetchTimestamp(documents, scan, fetchedAt): post-merge map that stamps fetchedAt only on records whose URL was actually fetched this run; manual, pinned, archive_pinned, file_url and source_sha256 records keep existing provenance.
base44/shared/permittingDiscoveryContinu: Removed fabricated last_fetched stamp from harvested scan documents.
Merged documents pass through applyDiscoveryFetchTimestamp before guarded persistence.
base44/functions/refreshJurisdiction/ent: Removed last_fetched: new Date().toISOString() from newAiDocs.
Merged documents pass through applyDiscoveryFetchTimestamp(merge, discoveryScan, now); no scan means no stamps.
base44/functions/batchUpdateJurisdiction: Removed fabricated last_fetched stamps from both AI document maps (AI suggestions are never fetched in that function).

test_changes.scripts/permitting-discovery-continuatio: Two new regression tests: fetched pending pages receive the timestamp while pending and harvested-only links stay undated; manual and archived records at fetched URLs keep earlier provenance.
test_changes.scripts/permitting-discovery-refresh.tes: Harness bindings added for applyDiscoveryFetchTimestamp and pre-existing missing retainOfficeResearchResponseHistory (pre-existing failure, unrelated to this change).
test_changes.scripts/jurisdiction-discovery-refresh.t: esbuild mock for safeExternalFetch.ts now also exports assertSafeExternalUrl (pre-existing failure; whole file could not build).

checks.focused_tests: 176 tests pass across discovery, refresh, continuation, frontier, dispatch, collection-cycle, archive, external-referrals and merge suites; 0 failures.
checks.prior_failures: Two pre-existing harness gaps (missing dep bindings) existed before this change and were repaired in the same files.

live_verification.method: base44 exec --privileged ran the actual deployed shared module continueKnownDiscovery once (maxPages=1) on live profile Octa / OH / 6ad05ac8acc3c782f0027f9c.
live_verification.fetch: https://www.fayette-co-oh.com/DocumentCenter/View/217/Zoning-Permit-Fees-PDF returned a cross-host redirect/no usable HTML and was recorded as page_fetch_failed gap with requires_review.
live_verification.outcome: 0 documents received new last_fetched; the failed page correctly received no fetch timestamp; all 15 pre-existing dates unchanged; 8 pending pages remain; llm_calls 0; provenance_violations [].
live_verification.note: Under the previous code every rediscovered harvested link would have been re-stamped this cycle. None were.

known_remaining_data_quality: Existing profile documents across OH/KY may still carry fabricated last_fetched dates written before this fix (Octa example: all 15 dated from a prior cycle). True fetch times are unknowable retroactively; bulk removal is a separate scoped decision requiring owner approval and is not performed here.
boundaries: No LLM calls, no dispatch spend, no archive uploads, no cap changes.
No authority, delegation, applicability or coverage conclusions drawn.
No frontend changes or publication. No client/job/shared records touched.
